summary: All 38 task-04 Playwright tests passed in Chromium, including seven new Web Audio startup regressions covering thrown setup operations, rejected resume, cancellation during resume, resource cleanup, and successful retry. The existing node tests/dictate.js check also passed. No product bug was reproduced. The required git add -A && git commit attempt failed before staging because Git could not create .git/index.lock on the read-only filesystem; the new test file and this report remain uncommitted. Transcription responses were stubbed, so real Groq mixed-language recognition was not verified.
